app.name: KhelTara
app.tagline: A 5-minute sporting check with the phone you already have.
home.mode.casual.sub: One short check. Share a card with your family.
home.mode.athlete.sub: Pick a sport. Test again. Watch your progress.
home.how: Hold the phone on your chest, or tie it with a dupatta or scarf. No other kit.
home.disclaimer: Screening for referral, not selection. Charts use provisional norms, not validated.
lang.title: Choose your language
lang.fallback: This language pack is not finished. English is shown until a native speaker reviews it.
onboard.title: About you
onboard.name: What should we call you?
onboard.need: Add your name and age to continue.
onboard.sport: Which sport are you hoping for?
onboard.hold.title: How to hold the phone
onboard.hold.body: Hold the phone flat on your chest with both hands. Elbows in. Or tie it there with a dupatta, scarf, or belt. A soft floor is better.
c0.script: We will type your age. If you know your height and weight, type them. For height, stand straight next to a wall. Put a book on your head. Mark the wall. Measure with a school ruler or measuring tape. Or tap Skip.
consent.title: A parent or guardian must agree
consent.body: You are under 18. A parent or guardian agrees before this screening is saved. We do not show ads.
consent.name: Parent or guardian name
consent.check: I am the parent or legal guardian. I agree to save this screening for this child. I understand this is not a selection.
consent.law: This step follows India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act for anyone under 18.
battery.title: Your 5-minute check
battery.sub: Six short tests. Rest whenever you need.
battery.sampleAll.sub: This fills the check with sample motion so you can learn the steps. It is not your body and not your score.
test.sample.sub: Sample motion, not your body. A real try uses the phone sensors.
test.buddy.script: Ask a friend or parent to watch. They can tap Ready and Done, hold your feet for sit-ups, and keep you safe.
test.ios: On iPhone, tap Allow when Safari asks to use motion.
err.cmj.shake: Phone moved too much — hold tighter.
err.cmj.knees: You bent knees in the air — jump straight and land soft.
err.cmj.unclear: Jump was too small or unclear — try again.
err.repeat.lost: We lost count — hold the phone steady and jump again.
err.balance.foot: Foot touched too soon — try again. Softly.
err.situp.small: Movement too small — sit up higher.
err.rt.early: Too early — wait for the signal.
err.step.miss: Step not seen — step higher with the beep.
err.ppg.finger: Finger not clear — cover the camera softly, no press hard.
err.sensor: This phone did not share motion. Allow sensors, or use a practice sample to learn the steps.
qc.lowRate: The phone samples were too slow. Hold still and try again.
cmj.ready: Hold the phone on your chest with both hands. Elbows in. Stand still. Soft floor is better. Bend knees, then jump up as high as you can. Keep holding the phone. Land soft. We will do one practice, then three jumps.
cmj.safety: If your knees or back hurt, skip this test.
repeat.ready: Same hold on the chest. When you hear go, keep jumping until the beep stops. Small quick jumps are OK. One practice of five seconds, then fifteen seconds.
repeat.safety: If your knees or back hurt, skip this test.
balance.ready: Hold phone to chest. Lift one foot. Stand like a tree. Try not to hop. Twenty seconds. Then other foot. Friend may stand near you.
balance.safety: Stand next to a wall. If you feel dizzy, stop.
situp.ready: Lie on your back. Knees bent. Phone on chest. Friend may hold your feet. Sit up until elbow near knee, then down. Do as many as you can in thirty seconds. One slow practice first.
situp.safety: Neck pain? Skip. Do not pull your neck with hands.
rt.ready: Hold the phone in your hand. Wait for the green light or sound. Then tap fast. Do not tap early. Practice three times.
tap.ready: Tap left-right as fast as you can for ten seconds.
step.ready: Find one safe step (stair or doorstep). Phone can sit in pocket or you hold it. Step up and down with the beeps. Then sit. Put your fingertip gently on the camera light. Stay still.
step.do: Up, down, up, down… Now finger on camera… still…
step.safety: Hold a railing. Stop if chest pain or dizziness.
sprint.ready: Put chappals or stones at start and end of about thirty steps of open ground. Hold phone or pocket. Wait for beep. Run straight past the end mark.
shuttle.ready: Two marks ten steps apart. Run back and forth four times to the voice.
results.title: Your screening card
results.disclaimer: Provisional norms, not validated. Screening for referral, not selection.
results.percentile: About {n} of 100 on the provisional chart
results.empty: Finish at least one test to see a card.
results.maturity: Growth-spurt estimate: {y} years (Mirwald). Not a medical test.
results.sampleNote: This card includes practice samples. Those numbers are not your body.
results.referral: A high clear score can be sent to a coach or centre for a real retest.
results.notSelection: This app does not select or reject anyone.
timeline.title: Your progress
timeline.empty: No checks saved yet. Your next check will show here.
invite.title: Invite friends
invite.sub: Share your link. When someone joins on a phone, they are counted here.
invite.people: People who joined with your code
invite.none: No one has joined with your code yet.
nominate.title: Spot a talent
nominate.sub: This only invites them. It does not create a score until they, or their parent, join and agree.
nominate.name: Their name
nominate.consent: The person, or their parent if they are under 18, has agreed to be contacted.
nominate.parent: A parent or guardian has agreed.
nominate.need: Consent is required. No scored profile is created from this form.
nominate.saved: Saved. They still need to join and agree.
nominate.spotter: Talent Spotter unlocks only after they join and pass a clear check.
family.title: Family
family.sub: A parent can add children. Each child has their own check.
family.consent: I am the parent or guardian and I agree to this child's screening.
profile.title: Profile
profile.centre.help: Centre-verified is for a retest at a club, school, or talent centre. Until then this profile stays self-tested.
profile.centre.name: Centre, school, or club
profile.centre.check: This was a centre retest, not only a home check.
demo.banner: Demo mode: results stay on this phone until a free backend is connected.
ppg.note: The camera stays in memory only. No video is saved.
